title: Kaydka
hint: Wax kasta oo aad iibiso, hal meel
card_products_desc: Ku dar ama beddel walxaha aad iibiso
access_denied_title: Waxaad u baahan tahay raad-raac kaydka
access_explanation: Tirinta kaydka, alaabta, iyo dhicitaanka waxay u baahan yihiin oggolaansho milkiilaha. Taabo si aad u dalbato.
access_pending_hint: Milkiilahaaga wuxuu helayaa ogeysiis. Raad-raacu wuxuu socon doonaa 4 saacadood marka la oggolaado.
access_error_pending: Codsi sugaya ayaad horeyba u haysatay.
access_error_generic: Codsiga lama diri karin. Isku day mar kale.
